clips.titulo: GTA 6 cops call AIR SUPPORT on you 🚁🚨
clips.descripcion:
Hide inside during a police siege and you can hear the cops radio for air support, and then the chopper shows up.

Gameplay: Truffle (YouTube)
#GTA6 #ViceCity #GTAVI
clips.comentario: Would you shoot the chopper down or run? 🚁
clips.motivo: Real police radio line plus the chopper payoff: strong cop-mechanics hook.

narracion.texto: Did you know GTA 6 cops call *air support*?
You just heard the *police radio*. They want a chopper on you.
Listen closely, there's *more*.
And then, look *up*.
There it is, the *helicopter* coming for you.

clips.descripcion:
Push your wanted level high enough and it is not just patrol cars anymore: a sheriff car, then a S.W.A.T. van with an officer in cover.

Gameplay: Truffle (YouTube)
#GTA6 #ViceCity #GTAVI
clips.comentario: How long would you survive against S.W.A.T.? 🚨
clips.motivo: S.W.A.T. van is clearly readable, but it is on screen only about a second.

narracion.texto: Did you know GTA 6 sends *S.W.A.T.* after you?
First a *sheriff* car, deputy right beside it.
Floor it, and they *open fire*.
Look left. A *S.W.A.T.* van, officer crouched behind it.
Rockstar went crazy with this *police AI*.

clips.titulo: GTA 6 cops can SPOT YOUR GUN 🔫👀
clips.descripcion:
While the cops are searching for you, GTA 6 warns that carrying a visible weapon may draw their attention.

Gameplay: Truffle (YouTube)
#GTA6 #ViceCity #GTAVI
clips.comentario: Would you holster your gun or keep it out? 🔫
clips.motivo: Readable on-screen tip about a real stealth/police mechanic.

narracion.texto: Did you know GTA 6 cops can *spot your gun*?
Cops are *searching* for you.
And the game warns you, a *visible weapon* draws their attention.
Put it *away* and blend in.

clips.titulo: GTA 6 GREY STARS mean the cops lost you ⭐👀
clips.descripcion:
When the cops lose sight of you in GTA 6, the wanted stars go grey and they start searching. Time to hide.

Gameplay: Truffle (YouTube)
#GTA6 #ViceCity #GTAVI
clips.comentario: Mangroves or the water, where are you hiding? 🌴
clips.motivo: Core wanted-level mechanic, grey stars clearly visible in scene 2.

narracion.texto: Did you know GTA 6 stars turn *grey* when cops lose you?
Watch. Out of the water and straight into the *mangroves*.
Up top, the stars are *grey* and flashing.
That means the cops *lost sight* and are searching for you.
Stay low, stay *hidden*, and keep moving.
Rockstar made hiding feel *real*.

clips.titulo: GTA 6 wanted stars show up EMPTY first ⭐🚨
clips.descripcion:
During this gun store job the wanted stars appear empty before any cop is around, and later they light up with police outside.

Gameplay: Truffle (YouTube)
#GTA6 #ViceCity #GTAVI
clips.comentario: Would you run the second the stars appear? ⭐
clips.motivo: Subtle HUD detail, small on a phone screen; second scene is dark.

narracion.texto: Did you know GTA 6 *wanted stars* show up empty?
Watch the top right corner in this *gun store*.
There. *Empty stars*, and not a single cop here yet.
Grab what you need, because this won't *last*.
Cops outside, and the stars *light up*.
